Corollary
[Length bound by swept area] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0271 ↗ lem:chow-iv-cusp-length-monotonicity 1. ch33:33.35\group Cusp comparison

At sufficiently large times, \[ L(0)\le \frac{e^{\varepsilon \bar\rho }}{1-e^{-\bar\rho }} \int _0^{\bar\rho }L(\rho )\, d\rho \le \frac{e^{\varepsilon \bar\rho }}{1-e^{-\bar\rho }}A(\bar\rho ) \] for every $0<\bar\rho <\rho _{A,B}(t)$, where $A(\bar\rho )$ is the disk area between depths zero and $\bar\rho $.
